title: Content-Disposition filename prefers RFC 5987 filename* with safe fallback
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag regex parsing of the header as fragile compared with a full MIME parser, or falling back to filename= on a malformed filename* as masking errors. The header grammar handled here is exactly the two parameter forms servers emit, quoted semicolons included, and the fallback keeps a usable name for broken senders while the result still passes through traversal stripping either way.
